# a2ui_v1_0_live

`catalog_definition_v1_0.json`: the A2UI v1.0 catalog meta-schema as saved from the live a2ui.org pages on 14 Nov 2026 (copied from the Ontology layer's saved sources, sha256 recorded there). Source project: a2ui-project/a2ui (Apache-2.0). Used by tests/test_pillar_pages.py to validate the catalog examples on the how-to guide. It is byte-identical to ../a2ui_v1_0_spec/json/catalog_definition.json (checked with cmp on 15 Nov 2026, and both equal the current v1.0 file on a2ui.org); an earlier note here called that one a release-candidate copy that differed, which was wrong. tests/test_site_count_consistency.py keeps the two identical. The guide follows this file, which allows leaf `$defs`, uses relative external `$ref`s, and bans structural combinators at the component root; the guide follows the live one. Its relative `$ref` to common_types.json is resolved with the common_types.json in ../a2ui_v1_0_spec/json (no live copy of that file is saved).
